message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to live air‑quality feeds, so I can’t give you the exact AQI for Los Angeles at this moment.  
Here’s what you can do to get the most up‑to‑date information:

| Source | How to check |
|--------|--------------|
| **AirNow** (U.S. EPA) | Visit <https://www.airnow.gov/> and enter “Los Angeles” or your ZIP code. |
| **EPA Air Quality Index (AQI) Mobile App** | Download the free app for iOS or Android and set Los Angeles as your location. |
| **Local news websites** | Many local stations (e.g., ABC7, KTLA) publish hourly AQI updates on their sites. |
| **Weather apps** | Apps like Weather.com, AccuWeather, or the built‑in weather app on most phones often display AQI. |

If you’re looking for a quick snapshot, you can also try a search query like “Los Angeles AQI” in your browser; most search engines pull the latest value from AirNow or the EPA.
